biomarkers.name: NR4A3 rearrangement / enhancer hijacking (including translocation involving 9q31)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic; NR4A3 overexpression is also detectable by NR4A3 IHC (nuclear staining)

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Serous acinar cells with cytoplasmic zymogen granules; solid, microcystic, papillary-cystic, or follicular patterns
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Traditionally low-grade; high-grade transformation is aggressive

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Serous acinar cells (parotid predominantly; occasionally submandibular)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Well-differentiated serous acinar cells with zymogen granules; ductal reserve cell origin proposed
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: High-grade transformation loses acinar differentiation and behaves aggressively
